Aditi and I have collaborated on several projects at FinTech Innovators Inc., where she’s consistently delivered insights that shape our product roadmap. As a peer, I’ve observed her thrive in cross-functional teams, balancing technical rigor with clear communication. Her ability to distill complex data into actionable strategies has been critical to our success in client-facing initiatives.  

Daily, Aditi’s work revolves around data storytelling. She’s mastered using Tableau and Power BI to create dashboards that cut through noise, whether it’s tracking loan performance metrics or visualizing customer segmentation. One consistent strength is her knack for anticipating stakeholder needs—she once redesigned a risk analysis dashboard to include real-time KPIs, which cut report generation time by 30%. Her attention to detail ensures even minor trends don’t slip through the cracks.  

A standout moment came when she identified an anomaly in transaction patterns that hinted at a hidden fraud vector. By drilling into the data, she helped the team refine our detection models, leading to a 15% improvement in flagged cases. Her curiosity and persistence in chasing leads like this are rare.  

Aditi is a reliable collaborator with a knack for turning data into strategic advantages. Her analytical depth and ability to simplify complex problems make her a standout hire. I’d welcome the chance to advocate for her contributions.
